# Keep unfinished drafts available after a browser reload

## What & Why
Draft recovery now survives switching between Answer library and Applications within the open tab, but a reload still clears the route-level recovery state. Persisting drafts would protect users who refresh or reopen the page before finishing.

## Done looks like
- A dismissed answer draft can be recovered after a browser reload.
- A dismissed opportunity draft can be recovered after a browser reload.
- The two draft types remain independent and expired drafts are not restored.
